en.title: Freelance
en.body: Looking to self-isolate during the worst of the COVID-19 pandemic, I returned to freelancing. As a technical consultant, I oversee ITSM projects and cybersecurity audits, ensuring the proper implementation of all processes necessary to guarantee stability and security in their future day to day production operations.
en.bullets:
Tasked with finding my own customers and negotiating my own sales
Building of long term relationships of mutual trust in order to ensure recurring work
Explanation of complex technical concepts in simple terms to non-technical actors
Representing my customers in technical workshops and negotiations with third parties
Introduction of processes into disorganized projects and technical teams
Assistance in auditing and recruiting new key figures for the customers' projects
Delivery of consulting reports, including roadmaps, and staffing & budgetting requirements

en.title: Wynd
en.body: Having raised 72m€ in series C funding, Wynd were looking to stabilize their projects by assembling a "Run" team. I was hired as the right hand of the head of run, in charge of the long term maintenance (OEM + TPM) of existing projects, tasked with ensuring the stability of production environments and establishing positive relationships with customers in order to upsell new features.
en.bullets:
Created the Run team, comprised of IT, support, maintenance, and systems administration
Assembled a team dedicated to application maintenance within the Run team
Established strong relationships with the Run teams of customers and third parties
Implemented ITILv4 and change management in order to increase production stability
Worked towards ISO27k normalization in order to reinforce security and reassure customers
Filled out complex security forms required by institutional customers in the finance sector
Handled multiple security audits and implemented improvements based on their feedback
Outsourced a developer taskforce in order to stabilize and modernize legacy projects
Outsourced application maintenance in order to have a flexible and scalable output
Handled legal and financial negotiations for these outsourcing deals
Set up KPIs and indicators in order to control the budgetting of this outsourced TPM
Renegotiated and improved most existing production contracts and legal deals with customers
Took part in the legal negotiations of all new projects to ensure they were mutually beneficial

fr.title: Wynd
fr.body: Ayant levé 72m€ en série C, Wynd cherchaient à stabiliser leurs projets en assemblant une équipe "Run". J'y ai été recruté en tant Responsable TMA, chargé d'encadrer la maintenance des projets finis, de garantir la stabilité des environnements de production, et d'établir des relations positives avec les clients sur le long terme dans le but de générer de l'upsell.
fr.bullets:
Création de l'équipe Run, composée d'IT, support, maintenance, et administration système
Assemblage d'une équipe TMA au sein de l'équipe Run dédiée à la maintenance applicative
Mise en place de relations avec les équipes Run des clients et des tiers
Implémentation d'ITILv4 et de gestion du changement afin de garantir une production stable
Quête d'une mise aux normes ISO27k afin de renforcer la sécurité et rassurer les clients
Remplissage de formulaires de sécurité complexes pour des clients de milieux exigeants
Gestion de multiples audits de sécurité et implémentation d'améliorations suite à ces audits
Externalisation d'une taskforce de développeurs dans le but de stabiliser les projets legacy
Externalisation d'une TMA dans le but d'avoir une livraison de correctifs flexible et scalable
Responsabilité de la négociation finacière et légale de ces externalisations
Mise en place de KPIs et d'indicateurs pour contrôler le budget de la TMA externalisée
Renégociation et amélioration de la majorité des contrats de production avec les clients
Négociation des contrats des nouveaux & futurs projets pour garantir qu'ils soient conformes
